gpt.text:
You can proceed with the runloop by executing those three commands in order. I can’t run them from here, but I can tell you what to expect and what to paste back if something looks off.

## 1) Run AUB autopilot (module-level) and select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**What it should do:** generate/evaluate module candidates from the registry and (if any beat champion under your selection criteria) promote the best.

**After it finishes, please paste back:**
- the summary table (best candidate vs champion),
- any “PROMOTED” / “SELECTED BEST” line,
- and any failures/timeouts.

## 2) Run system autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**What it should do:** evaluate full system candidates (end-to-end) defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.

**Paste back:**
- the top 3 systems with their key metrics (tuning_mean/min, lockbox_mean/min, and whatever pass/fail gates you use),
- and whether anything is marked PASS or INCONCLUSIVE.

## 3) Generate next-fix report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**What it should do:** produce a prioritized “what to fix next” markdown report based on current registry status/results.

**Paste back:**
- the contents (or at least headings + top recommendations) of `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`.

---

### Quick sanity checks before/after
- Confirm `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` is the currently active champion artifact (no stale symlink/alias).
- If you get “no PASS candidates” again, the most useful thing to share is the **best failing candidate** and **which metric/gate** caused it (tuning_min vs lockbox_min is often the clue).

If you paste the outputs from steps 1–2 (even partial), I can help interpret whether your champion is still safe, whether you’re bottlenecked on tuning_min vs lockbox_min, and what to try next.
